fichas.title: Design Basics: Housing and Residential Space
fichas.summary: Residential design balances inhabitants’ lifestyles and individual requirements with regulations, planning policies, and architectural approaches. The page surveys historical housing development, changing relationships between private and communal life, room-use patterns, and the move toward flexible, functionally neutral spaces. Diagrams illustrate daily routines, traditional room divisions, and room occupancy periods with desirable sunlight.
